messages: Adele: Heads up — mkdocs is failing in CI after the i18n folder cleanup, looks like a bunch of anchors changed. Mike: saw the CI alert, re-running locally now. any example of a failing link? Adele: yes — /docs/usage/cli#auth-token used to work, now it 404s in the compiled site. the HTML id shows up as `auth-token-legacy` in the build. Sina: hmm that sounds like slugify differences from the migration step. maybe some non-ascii or parentheses were normalized differently. Claire: I pushed a quick patch that normalizes header IDs in our mkdocs plugin, but it's failing on some autogenerated snippets. Adele: repro steps I used: `git checkout main && mkdocs build -d /tmp/site && grep -R "auth-token" /tmp/site | head`. Mike: ran that, got `auth-token-legacy` and `auth_token` both present in different pages. looks like a mix of old and new slug rules. Sina: could be two sources: older markdown files with explicit anchors and newer mkdocs-slugify plugin behavior. we should prefer a single canonical slugization. Claire: proposed fix: run a pre-commit script to standardize explicit header IDs (convert `{: #id}` to our canonical `id`) and run linkcheck after. I can open a PR. Adele: yes please. also can we add a mapping fallback in the link checker so redirects are suggested instead of hard failures? saves churn. docs-bot: linkcheck job started on branch: `docs/anchor-normalize-333` — running with `--map-fallback` disabled. Mike: for quick unblocks, we can add HTML anchors next to the header as a temporary shim: `` — but that's messy. prefer automatic mapping. Claire: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/589 — includes pre-commit script and a small mkdocs plugin tweak. tests added. Sina: will review. can we also add a unit test that validates that every internal link resolves after the mapping? something like `pytest tests/test_linkmap.py`. Adele: yes add that test and include an example where old slug -> new slug is asserted. Mike: FYI deploy-bot reported one flaky linkcheck on staging earlier: `Failed links: 3` — might be related. deploy-bot: staging deploy 2026-03-23T08:12:31Z: linkcheck returned non-zero exit. See logs: https://ci.internal/logs/anchor-check-333 Claire: updated PR with the test and enabled map-fallback in linkcheck. re-running CI now. docs-bot: linkcheck job passed on PR 589 with fallback map enabled. 0 unresolved links. :tada: Adele: nice. can we add a short migration note in docs/migration.md explaining the slug changes and how to find impacted pages? keep it 1-2 lines and a command to run the linkchecker locally. Claire: added a short section and a sample command: `pipx run mkdocs-linkcheck --site-dir=site --map-file=anchor-map.json`. Sina: LGTM. I'll merge after CI green and then we should monitor the next full site build for any leftover regressions. Mike: thanks all — great coordination. :thumbsup:
